features.name: Power BI apps for Business Central
features.description: Free apps from Microsoft available on AppSource that can be deployed and embedded in Business Central with zero coding required. Nine pre-built Power BI applications available including Finance, with template app deployment that includes semantic model but no embedded data.
caveats: Version-specific compatibility required
Requires Power BI license
Paid alternatives available on AppSource
Only available for SaaS environments, not on-prem NAV
Apps must match Business Central version

features.name: Five-click deployment for Business Central Power BI apps
features.description: A simplified deployment mechanism that was coming out in version 28 to deploy Business Central apps, though it was limited to development environments and sandbox only.
caveats: Only in sandbox/development environment
Does not work with regular/production apps
Development environment limited
Not functional with regular apps

features.name: Power BI workspace setup and access control
features.description: Power BI workspaces consist of reports, models, and dashboards with four access levels: administrator, contributor, member, and viewer only, allowing granular permission management for apps.
caveats: Requires checking with IT department
May require Power BI license

features.name: Power BI pagination report feature
features.description: Capability to convert online Power BI reports into paginated reports for printing and Excel export, available through the Power BI service.
caveats: Requires Power BI service access
Power BI is primarily designed for online consumption

features.name: Power BI native APIs and web services connection
features.description: Business Central can connect to Power BI through native APIs and web services, allowing Power BI Desktop to consume data from Business Central online.
caveats: Requires Power BI Desktop
Can also use Fabric and other data warehouses

features.name: Power BI Pro license with 8 daily refreshes
features.description: Power BI Pro license enables publishing reports to service with up to 8 refresh schedules per day and 1 gigabyte memory usage, suitable for Business Central apps.
caveats: Each user accessing reports needs Pro license
Free trial lasts 60 days
Consumers also need Pro license

features.name: Power BI Premium license with 48 daily refreshes
features.description: Power BI Premium license option supporting very large data models and 48 refresh cycles per day for premium workspaces with higher data usage.
caveats: Needed only for high data volume scenarios
More expensive than Pro license

features.name: Template app file type
features.description: A Power BI file type that contains the data model and semantic structure behind reports without embedding actual data, used for the Business Central apps.
caveats: Requires data connection after installation
No embedded data in deployment

features.name: PBIX file format
features.description: Standard Power BI Desktop file format used since the beginning for saving reports with embedded data.

features.name: PBIT template file format
features.description: Power BI template file format for sharing reports without data, allowing users to connect their own data sources.

features.name: PBIP and PBIR project files
features.description: Advanced Power BI file types for project and report files supporting version control within Power BI.
caveats: More advanced usage
For version control purposes

features.name: Connect your data feature
features.description: Functionality in Power BI template apps to connect demo data to actual Business Central company and environment data after installation.
caveats: Requires correct company name and environment name
OAuth 2 authentication required
Common user errors with data entry

features.name: Power BI App Connection to Business Central
features.description: Connect Power BI apps to Business Central by providing the environment name and company name obtained from the Business Central URL or Help and Support section.
caveats: Customers often enter incorrect information in screenshots
Must use correct email address matching Business Central login domain

features.name: OAuth 2 Authentication for Power BI
features.description: OAuth 2 is the recommended authentication method with organization-level privacy settings for connecting Power BI to Business Central.
caveats: May require manual login even with cached credentials
MFA may require additional authentication steps
Email must match Business Central domain

features.name: Power BI App Connection Status Indicator
features.description: A yellow bar appears at the top of the app indicating data connection status; the bar disappears when successfully connected and may reappear if connection is lost due to upgrades or other issues.
caveats: May become disconnected after Business Central upgrades

features.name: Power BI App Migration
features.description: When updating to a later version of Business Central, users can migrate existing Power BI apps or remove and redo them. Migration preserves app changes while uninstalling loses customizations.
caveats: Uninstalling without migrating loses all app customizations
Must choose migrate if model changes have been made

features.name: Multi-Company Power BI App Installation
features.description: Install Power BI apps for multiple companies by reinstalling the app with a new workspace name for each company and connecting to different companies in Business Central.
caveats: Must install and connect the app once for each company
Requires separate workspace names for each company installation

features.name: Power BI Apps as Embedded Business Central Reports
features.description: Power BI apps can be embedded and displayed in Business Central through the All Reports section, accessible to employees and customers without requiring direct Business Central access.
caveats: Power BI reports are not native Business Central reports
Apps must be installed in workspace before connecting

features.name: Power BI Assisted Setup Wizard
features.description: An assisted setup wizard guides users through configuring Power BI reports in Business Central, including selecting fiscal or standard calendar types, date ranges, time zones, and working days.
caveats: Calendar type selection is important for date table generation
Settings can be changed after initial setup

features.name: Date Table Generation in Power BI
features.description: Date tables are automatically created in Power BI apps based on selected calendar type (fiscal or standard) and configured date range. The table can be updated by pushing out the end date.
caveats: Date table must be manually updated when years are added

features.name: Accounting Periods Integration with Power BI
features.description: Instead of using Power BI date tables, connect directly to the Business Central accounting periods table via web service or API to automatically update date tables when new years are created.
caveats: Requires Power BI report development knowledge
Uses web service or API connection

features.name: Power BI Connector Setup in Business Central
features.description: The Power BI Connector Setup page in Business Central allows configuration of workspace apps, calendar types, time zones, working days, and account category mappings.
caveats: Workspace name changes break links and require reconnection

features.name: Power BI Account Categories Mapping
features.description: Account subcategories in Business Central must be mapped to Power BI report account categories through the Power BI Account Categories setup to ensure financial reports display correctly segmented.
caveats: Power BI report categories are set statically
Requires manual mapping if Business Central subcategories change

features.name: Power BI Semantic Model Customization
features.description: Later versions of Business Central allow modification of Power BI semantic models using Power BI Desktop to customize dashboards and reports.
caveats: Requires Power BI Desktop installation
Semantic model changes must be made in workspace, not in app

features.name: Power BI Desktop semantic model editing
features.description: Users can download and edit the semantic model in Power BI Desktop to customize visualizations, add filters, change colors, and modify report layouts.
caveats: Download semantic model, not the report
Need Power BI Desktop installed to open files

features.name: Power BI Pro license requirement for publishing
features.description: Publishing changes back to the Power BI service requires a Power BI Pro license. The publish button is located in the middle of the Power BI Desktop screen.
caveats: Backup of files recommended before publishing to avoid overwriting changes
Dataset replacement can overwrite previous versions

features.name: App update workflow in Power BI service
features.description: After publishing changes to the workspace semantic model, users must update the app in Power BI service using the update button in the right hand corner. Update typically takes 5 to 15 minutes.
caveats: Workspace changes do not automatically update the app
Separate update step required after publishing to workspace

features.name: Multi-company app deployment
features.description: When deploying Power BI apps with multiple companies, the same update and configuration process must be repeated for each company.
caveats: App unpublishing and republishing generates new links
Users must receive updated links if app is republished

features.name: Business Central mirroring to Fabric
features.description: New feature that enables mirroring Business Central data to Microsoft Fabric. Available on Business Central 29.1 and later versions with backfill planned for 29.0. Requires a paid Fabric capacity license (starting around $250-500 per month).
caveats: Only available on BC 29.x versions, not 28.5
Requires paid Fabric capacity (F-SKU licensing)
Available on marketplace
Free 60-day trial for Fabric license available

features.name: Fabric mirrored database setup
features.description: Mirrored database feature within Fabric integration requires Fabric capacity availability and specific F-SKU licensing. F2 is the lowest SKU option, costing approximately $250 per month, with Microsoft guidance of $300-500 per month for Fabric capacity with Business Central.
caveats: Licensing model not finalized
Requires F-SKU licenses
Pricing guidance is $300-500 per month

features.name: Multi-company reporting with Fabric
features.description: Fabric integration enables multi-company reporting from a single installed app. Previously, apps had to be installed multiple times for each company. With Fabric, users can install one app and change companies within it.
caveats: Mirroring is instantaneous (not refreshing)
No multicurrency support currently
Requires editing models for multicurrency workaround

features.name: Fabric table mirroring selectivity
features.description: Fabric mirroring allows selective mirroring of specific Business Central tables rather than the entire database. Users only mirror tables needed for their apps or reporting.
caveats: If using standard apps, all app tables must be mirrored
Only needed tables must be mirrored for custom solutions

features.name: Fabric-ready Power BI apps
features.description: Upcoming Power BI apps that will be fabric-ready and available for Business Central, requiring correct version selection.
features.status_evidence_quote: they will have fabric ready apps that will be available also
caveats: apps coming out in the future
version compatibility needed

features.name: MCP servers for Power BI with Copilot
features.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers integration enabling Power BI report creation through AI assistance with Claude in Copilot, reducing need to write DAX code manually.
caveats: still in development phase
presenter submitted sessions on this topic
reduces but does not eliminate coding
